# Records (fixture)

## Id prefixes

| Prefix | Record |
|---|---|
| `D-` | Decision |
| `F-` | Finding |
| `R` (no hyphen) | Review item |

## Status sets

| Set | Values | Where |
|---|---|---|
| Decision | proposed · accepted · superseded | Register |
| Document status | draft · accepted | Stage report |
| Review | item: open · closed · accepted as a known limitation; round: approved · approved with changes · rework | Review |
